name: 炎龙封印（笑傲江湖·阿飞站）
english_name: Seal of the Fire Dragon (Laughing in the Wind: Afei's Server)
english_description: Belongs to the Sunset Reappears (XYZX/YLFY) engine family; its in-game login banner reads "Sunset Reappears: Laughing in the Wind." This build is a deep independent reworking by developer "Afei," built atop an earlier Fire Dragon branch modified by "Suimeng" — making it a distant cousin, rather than a direct copy, of the other Sunset Reappears games in this collection's engine family.
